scope: Idle Finder title activation, keyboard navigation, alternate file managers and folder browsing without an installed file manager.

checks.command: pytest -q tests/test_globalmenu_model.py in a private Xvfb and D-Bus session (1 passed, model, popup, and QML composition).

VM: clicked idle Finder and selected New Finder Window with Nautilus and Dolphin executables and desktop entries moved aside. Opened a text file from the fallback chooser, observed Kate running with /home/tester/proof.txt.
VM: selected a third-party desktop-entry recorder as the directory handler and verified it received /home/tester.
VM: cleared explicit directory association with both known managers absent. Final candidate opened the file chooser at Home instead of launching the project editor.
Verified the published Tahoe archive SHA-256, VERSION, edition support and staged defaults. Ran the Golden Gate wrapper suite.

environment: Golden Gate, KDE neon User Edition 24.04, Plasma 6.8.1, Wayland, disposable QEMU overlay
coverage_limits: Desktop capture on Golden Gate with Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland. Alternate handler routing used a desktop-entry recorder.
